'''''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: Force War''''' is a five-issue [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries that is the third story arc in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'', a comic book series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] and written by the creative team of [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]]. Set [[25,792 BBY|one]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the events of the previous story arc, [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan|''The Prisoner of Bogan'']], ''Force War'' deals with the [[Invasion of the Tython system|invasion]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. As the miniseries opens, the Rakata have conquered half of the Tython system, and the [[Je'daii]] use the [[Forcesaber]]s—the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] weapons of the Rakata—to defend their home against the invaders. [[Predor]] [[Skal'nas]] of the Empire seeks to invade [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and locate the [[Infinity Gate]] rumored to have been built there by the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] species, which he hopes will elevate him into power.
